headline: ION Exchange (India) Limited: Substantial Acquisition Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: ION Exchange (India) Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure under the SEBI Takeover Code, signalling a material change in shareholding or an acquisition trigger event requiring public disclosure of acquirer identity, consideration, conditions and timeline.
detail: ION Exchange (India) Limited, a water-treatment and air-purification chemicals manufacturer with a strong industrial heritage, has triggered the mandatory disclosure regime under SEBI's Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers Regulations, 2011. The Regulation 31(4) filing is filed post-event: it requires disclosure of the acquirer's identity, shareholding %, consideration per share, number of shares acquired, the date of acquisition, and whether the acquisition was direct/indirect or through an open offer trigger. The disclosure does not itself name the acquirer in the NSE archive title, requiring the full PDF of the disclosure document to identify the actual buyer and deal quantum. This is a mandatory reporting requirement under the Takeover Code; the fact of filing confirms a substantial (typically ≥25%) or creeping (typically ≥5% in a rolling quarter) acquisition has been consummated or is in advanced negotiation.
